_avail.description: 600 mm Frequency Invariant Beamforming Ceiling Tile Microphone Array White with Dante and 4 x 15 Watt PoE amplifier
_avail.portsMissing: BMA 360D-I Black page has no documents; the BMA 360D-I sheet (from the White page) covers it. The sheet gives 4 amplifier channels on 5.08 mm Euroblock but not whether they share one block or use one block per channel; modelled as one port per channel.
